# PaperSend

Turn a PDF into real US mail. Muse drafts your letter from a PDF, addresses it, and shows you a private review link with the rendered pages — you confirm and pay before anything prints. $4.99 for the first page, $0.25 per extra page (US Letter, 1–5 pages, First Class postage included). Created by Telep IO; fulfillment and billing run through their service at muse.telep.io.
